correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, the known instantaneous step mean is sinh(cx)/(2 sinh x) with x=(L/2)√(r/D), so the physical speed at fixed L is rL times this mean. Its logarithmic derivative in x is H=2/x+c coth(cx)−coth x. Strict convexity gives sinh(cx)<c sinh x, hence H_x<0. Its endpoint limits are +∞ and c−1<0; its unique zero is a global maximum in both x and r. H_c=(sinh(cx)cosh(cx)−cx)/sinh²(cx)>0 for cx>0, so the maximizer increases strictly with c. As c→1, monotonicity and H(x,1)=2/x exclude a finite root limit. The mean-value theorem applied to u coth(ux_*) then gives 2/x_*=(1−c)(1+o(1)), including the stated squared divergence in r. c=0 is a zero-current model, not a distinguished optimum. Independent bounded replay: python3 /workspace/repairs/4/check.py, output /workspace/branches/repaired-4-check.txt; eight sampled critical points satisfy derivative signs and ordering and three scaled near-endpoint roots pass. The analytic sign and limit arguments, not the numerical samples, prove the theorem. The original dispersion formula is not removed for incorrectness: from the Laplace excursion endpoints one obtains E[N], E[N²] and E[NT]=E[N]/r−∂r E[N]; the centered cycle variance per mean cycle time yields the stated coefficient. To justify variance convergence rather than only a CLT, stop the martingale of centered iid rewards at the first cycle crossing the observation time. Its second moment is the single-cycle variance times rt+1. The crossing duration is bounded in second moment by the sum of an exponentially dominated age and an exponential residual; conditioning on alarm times bounds the crossing reward and the unfinished displacement in L² uniformly, so their omission changes variance by o(t). Independent tilted-kernel derivative checks of the original formula at four parameters are in /workspace/branches/independent-4.txt (python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 4).
